release.notes: Safety precaution (INC-2026-022): on the Kia Niro EV and Hyundai Kona Electric 2023–25, extended ECU scans, DTC read/clear, the All Sensors module scan and Remote Tuning beyond regular data reads stay off until validated on a car; pre-purchase report shows unknown capacity instead of implying no loss, demo checks are never saved or shared; Battery Test 100→0% certificate graded only after a complete discharge; new numeric font on the dashboard; charging card shows session kWh first; messages can be closed; Chinese drive and charging PDFs; Jaecoo J5 58.9: 41 new All Sensors rows.
